source.rule: explicit LongNote type wins; TYPE_UNDEFINED selects by BMSModel lntype 0=LN, 1=CN, 2=HCN

cases.name: frame-lifetime
cases.behavior: one owned state/projection snapshot is visible only between a strictly increasing begin and its first commit or discard

cases.name: timer-off-sentinel
cases.behavior: every nonnegative timer ID is recognized; an unavailable value is exactly -9223372036854775808 without an unsupported diagnostic

cases.name: gauge-families
cases.behavior: types 0 through 2 are groove, types 3 through 5 are hard, and deciles plus qualification use the captured compiled gauge maximum and border

cases.name: audited-full-title
cases.behavior: string 12 is supported only when the immutable chart model contains an audited string-12 value; title is not substituted

cases.name: custom-objects-pending
cases.behavior: nonempty custom maps are explicitly unsupported until one session orchestrator owns the Lua frame shared by pre-draw custom callbacks and Skin2DRenderer evaluation
